preconditions.description: Attacker must have sufficient PLENTYCOIN tokens to cover the buyback transfer amount
Contract must have accumulated token balance >= numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity (500000 * 10^6 * 10^18 wei)
swapAndLiquifyEnabled must be true (default is true)
inSwapAndLiquify must be false (not currently in swap process)

exploit_hint: 1. First ensure the contract has accumulated tokens >= numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity by transferring tokens to the contract address. 2. Trigger a token transfer transaction (to any address) that will invoke _transfer(). 3. When _transfer() detects contractTokenBalance >= numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity, it will call swapAndLiquify(). 4. Inside swapAndLiquify(), the line transfer(_buyBackAddress, rest) will incorrectly deduct tokens from msg.sender (the attacker) instead of the contract balance. 5. The attacker loses tokens equal to 'rest' (20% of contractTokenBalance) which are sent to _buyBackAddress. Verify by checking attacker's token balance decreased after the transaction.
